cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Let the Callback Claim Credit
cards.instruction: Get recognition by returning to an early overlooked contribution when its importance becomes undeniable.

mechanism: Copy hiding a key without understanding the first key's purpose, then demand recognition when that accidental spare arrangement becomes useful.
confusable: Not informed contingency planning: B2 must expose the copied model and A must pretend intentional backup before the actual lockout proves its value.
comparison: Household access and credit for a spare key differ from stage equipment surviving a failure.
seedUse: Retains flowerpot spare key and delayed named credit; adds copied placement of a key awaiting collection.
